title: Grilled White Cabbage Skewers with Mediterranean Kissed Sauce
description: A refreshing summer side dish featuring juicy white cabbage and a zesty Mediterranean kissed sauce, perfect for outdoor gatherings.
instructions: Cut the white cabbage into 1-inch pieces and separate into leaves.
Thread the cabbage leaves onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the olive oil on both sides of the cabbage and season with salt.
Grill the cabbage skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, until slightly charred.
Meanwhile, mix the lemon juice and garlic in a small bowl.
Remove the skewers from the grill and brush with the lemon-garlic mixture.
Serve the grilled cabbage skewers with kissed sauce on the side.
